G1.name: Frozen fixture identity
G1.requirement: Record the de-branded fixture identity and provenance.
G1.evidence: Frozen fixture and fixture manifest paths.

G2.name: Immutable evaluation inputs
G2.requirement: Keep the live Atlas snapshot and source fixture immutable during the run.
G2.evidence: Frozen Atlas snapshot and fixture revision records.

G3.name: Question and truth isolation
G3.requirement: Keep paired questions and ground truth isolated from authoring roles.
G3.evidence: Protected question, persona, and ground-truth paths.

G4.name: Verified cold baseline
G4.requirement: Verify the cold Atlas baseline before interrogation.

G5.name: Governed Atlas authoring
G5.requirement: Record governed authoring, validation, and independent review.
G5.evidence: Protected Atlas snapshot and review evidence paths.

G6.name: Pure retrieval arms
G6.requirement: Keep Atlas-only and raw-source-only retrieval arms within their tool policies.
G6.evidence: Frozen tool-policy and per-arm telemetry paths.

G7.name: Answer integrity
G7.requirement: Verify citations, fabrication handling, absence, and honest refusal.
G7.evidence: Protected answer, telemetry, and ground-truth evidence paths.

G8.name: Pre-judge reproducibility
G8.requirement: Freeze inputs before judging and score the comparison deterministically.
G8.evidence: Master freeze manifest, rubric, and protected scoring inputs.
